name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Oil drops over 4% as Middle East tensions ebb on diplomatic efforts
changes.summary: Oil prices fell on Monday as investors pared geopolitical risk premiums after U.S. President Donald Trump said he had called off a planned strike on Iran.

changes.title: Trump says Iran talks to resume Monday after calling off planned strikes
changes.summary: The latest peace proposal calls for warring parties to return to negotiations and continue working out some of the thorny issues that derailed diplomatic efforts.

changes.title: Trump says Iran talks set for Monday as Tehran and Oman discuss strait of Hormuz deal
changes.summary: The US president did not provide details of where Monday meeting would take place or who would be involved Donald Trump said talks with Iran will happen on Monday but declined to set a deadline for an agreement after earlier saying he had called ⁠off an imminent attack in the hope ⁠of quickly reaching a deal to ​reopen.

changes.title: Politics chat: Will Democrats use the war and high prices for their midterm strategy?
changes.summary: We look at how the Democratic party is approaching the midterms, and if they are using issues like the war in Iran and affordability, to their advantage.

changes.title: Trump Says He Canceled Strikes on Iran, Claiming Progress on Outlines of a Deal
changes.summary: President Trump has repeatedly threatened to escalate the war with Iran, only to abruptly back down. Saudi Arabia said its leader had urged Trump not to renew attacks.

changes.title: Trump admin. touts its transparency. Yet few Iran war details have been shared.
changes.summary: The Trump administration is offering the public less information about the Iran war and its direction, even as the costs continue to mount.

changes.title: Fact-checking Trump's claims about how the Iran war is going
changes.summary: Even as a ceasefire was crumbling, leading the U.S. to wage new attacks on Iran, President Donald Trump touted the United States' war as a success.

changes.title: Trump backs down on Iran strikes in expectation of ‘rapidly’ reaching a deal
changes.summary: US president claims delay is also in response to requests from Iran and other countries in the region Donald Trump has said he cancelled planned military strikes against Iran on the basis of “rapidly” reaching a deal on its nuclear programme and the full reopening of the strait of Hormuz. changes.title: Iran Plotted Wider War With Help of Its Proxies
changes.summary: During a fleeting truce, Iranians covertly devised a plan to raise the war’s costs for President Trump if U.S. forces attacked anew.

changes.title: Here’s the biggest news you missed this weekend
changes.summary: President Donald Trump agreed to pause attacks on Iran on Saturday, citing “perimeters of a deal” that would end Tehran’s “nuclear threat” and reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
